description: Find your graduate jobs, internships or placements across the UK, directly in ChatGPT. Search by role, location or sector, check requirements and deadlines, and explore opportunities from leading employers. When you’re ready, open the full listing on targetjobs to apply. Plus, discover career events, tools and advice built for students and recent graduates.
